Description
The University of Liverpool is one of the six original 'red brick' civic universities and is a founding member of the Russell Group. The university is five minutes walk from Liverpool City Centre and contains 192 non-residential buildings that house 69 lecture theatres, 114 teaching areas and research facilities. The 2018 U.S. News & World Report ranks Liverpool 129th in the world and 15th in the UK according to the Round University Ranking.
﻿The University of Liverpool is renowned for excellent teaching and research, which specifically relates to the professions including Medicine, Dentistry, Business Law, Architecture and Engineering.
